\par\vspace{2pt}
\begin{minipage}{\linewidth}\scriptsize\raggedright
Protocol: for every (family, method, seed) the task index $z$ is inferred from 10,000 random training transitions labelled with the family's reward on the next state (+1.0 shift, as in the table protocol), through each method's own \texttt{infer\_cond}; the frozen policy is then rolled for 20 episodes of the env's standard length (200 / 500 steps, no early termination) and the family's reward is scored on every visited state. Regions are discs of radius 0.06\,m in the table plane: cube-single A~$=(0.48, 0.23)$, B~$=(0.48, -0.23)$; cube-double A~$=(0.5, 0.23)$, B$_0$~$=(0.5, -0.1)$ (cube 2's start under the fixed task-2 reset used for R6). R1: $r=\mathbf{1}[\text{cube}\in A]$. R2: $r=\max(\mathbf{1}[A],\mathbf{1}[B])$. R3: $r_a=\mathbf{1}[A]+0.3\,\mathbf{1}[B]$, $r_b=0.3\,\mathbf{1}[A]+\mathbf{1}[B]$. R4: $r=\mathrm{clip}((z_{\text{cube}}-0.02)/0.10,0,1)$. R5: $r=-\|\text{cube}-g\|$ with $g$ each eval task's goal (5 targets $\times$ 4 episodes), against the sparse $r=\mathbf{1}[\|\text{cube}-g\|\le 0.04]$ on the same targets. R6: $r=\mathbf{1}[\text{cube}_1\in A]-0.5\,\mathbf{1}[\text{cube}_2\notin B_0]$. R7: $r=\max(\mathbf{1}[\text{cube}_1\in A],\mathbf{1}[\text{cube}_2\in A])$. Checkpoints: FB = fb\_tdj, Density-FB = density\_fb\_z, HILP = hilp\_tdjc, RLDP = rldp at ortho 1 (exp/ortho1), Density-RLDP = rldp\_density\_reg (ortho 1), Density-HILP = hilp\_density\_reg; the two density retrofits have no cube-double run (``---'').
\end{minipage}
\end{table}
